mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 7.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE exceeding 7.0% in the labor market tightening regime, or the unemployment rate does not sustain the threshold for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward trends, or the correlation between the proxies and returns is below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive during the tightening cycle, or the federal funds rate does not exhibit a sustained upward trend over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO shows sustained growth, or the correlation between INDPRO and returns falls below 0.25 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 10.0 million signals strong labor market absorption, stimulating consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive despite PAYEMS exceeding 10.0 million, or the employment figure does not sustain the threshold for 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) and industrial demand (RSAFS) indicates broad-based economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS show upward trends, or the interaction effect (product of proxies) has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing demand (HOUST) signals weakening consumption momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite HOUST declining in the late-cycle expansion regime, or the correlation between HOUST decline and returns is below 0.2.
